SIDE LETTER AGREEMENT

Recitals: the Investor is a public pension institution subject to the Bavarian transparency act.

1. Disclosure. Nothing in the Partnership Agreement shall prevent the Investor from making disclosures required by any freedom of information or public records law.
2. Excuse. The Investor shall be excused from any investment in weapons or munitions manufacturers where its participation would breach the investment regulations applicable to it.
3. Notice. Capital calls shall be made on not less than twenty (20) Business Days' notice to the Investor.
4. Advisory Committee. The Investor shall be entitled to appoint one member of the Advisory Committee.
